thread_text:
elena: Random question — what's a book that totally blindsided you emotionally? Drop a song you turned to after finishing it :)
samir: 'A Little Life' — I was NOT ready. Song: 'Holocene' by Bon Iver. :sob:
lia: 'The Road' — me and my partner sat in silence on the couch for like 10 minutes after the last page. Song: 'Saturn' by Sleeping At Last. Quiet and weirdly hopeful.
tom: 'Never Let Me Go' wrecked me. Song that stuck: 'There Is A Light That Never Goes Out' (The Smiths).
maya: Cried on the subway finishing 'The Kite Runner'. Song: 'Fix You' by Coldplay. Embarrassing but effective. :grimacing:
elena: @samir oh god yes. 'A Little Life' is a feelings grenade. I have a recovery playlist (90s alt + ambient) — https://open.spotify.com/playlist/3xyzABC 
samir: Saved the link — playlist is a vibe. For short catharsis: 'The Ocean at the End of the Lane' + 'Skinny Love' (Bon Iver).
lia: tiny poll? Which do you reach for after a heavy read: 1) Sad indie 2) Chill ambient 3) Upbeat pop 4) Nothing, need silence. react with :one:, :two:, :three:, :four:
tom: :two: ambient. Himalayan drone/Max Richter for me.
maya: :three: upbeat pop cleanse. mandatory dance session.
elena: :four: sometimes silence + tea, but usually ambient.
ops-bot: poll created by elena (reactions tracked).
samir: recs: ambient — Stars of the Lid, Max Richter 'On The Nature of Daylight'. Pop cleanse — 'Dog Days Are Over' (Florence + The Machine).
lia: book rec for a lighter, healing read: 'The Storied Life of A.J. Fikry' — gentle comfort. Song: 'Home' by Edward Sharpe & The Magnetic Zeros.
tom: Movie pairing rec: 'About Time' followed by 'Amélie' for maximum warm fuzzy.
maya: thanks everyone — making a 'post-book recovery' playlist now. anyone want to collab? drop a song.
elena: yes! add 'Holocene' and 'Saturn'.
samir: added. :thumbsup:
